neutral_pooled6.ci_method: REML with the joint-bootstrap sampling covariance (§17.1)

mini.note: outcome known before PR§21 (H36); reported, untested

R2.note: single_side is PR§20.2's R2 estimand (questions whose flag on the gold pair names one side; at most one such flag per question, so flag and question counts agree); direction = metrics.direction_accuracy as §11.3 coded it ('both' a miss, 'unclear' skipped), reported beside it. The two coincide for gpt-4o-mini, which never answers 'both'. Sonnet: no closed-book run. The HealthContradict part waits for the PR§20.3 human labels.

R3.note: single-side precision first tabulated on 2026-11-02 while writing the triage (disclosed in PR§20.2)

R4.note: followed = per-question share of flagged seeds following the flag (revision10._follow); logistic with fractional outcomes, one observation per question and generator, generator fixed effects

R8.note: API completion_tokens, conflict questions, seed means within questions; for luna, terra and Claude they include hidden reasoning tokens

supplementary_cb_too.note: not registered in PR§20: H19's ConflictBank terra plain also swapped, to randdir_cb_terra's draw

R9.cap_rule: config.json has no max_tokens; generator calls use llm.OpenAILLM's default 256, raised to 4096 for ['claude-haiku-5-5', 'claude-sonnet-5-5', 'gpt-6-luna', 'gpt-6.1-terra']; MADAM, Astute and TrustRAG rows sum several calls, so their at-cap share is not defined (null)

R13.note: first tabulated on 2026-11-02 (TRIAGE_REVIEW10 B.3); descriptive, does not test label noise

R16.note: conflict: coverage (1 - abstention), selective accuracy, one-way misinformation share (R12), one-way strict accuracy; clean: the same without misinformation; points with question-bootstrap CIs, flag minus plain with paired question-bootstrap CIs; selective = §15.4.5 ratio (sum correct / sum answered over question x seed, as H21c_ratio and Table 2), selective_perq = the per-question mean

cb_distractors.build: ConflictBank: the correct passage plus three off-subject distractors (the majority variant reuses the same clean items)

ramdocs_multi.build: RAMDocs: questions without misinformation, mostly with several valid answers

raguard.build: RAGuard: claims with supporting posts and no misleading post

R18.note: gpt-4o-mini LLM detector, directional flag; effect(pi) = pi K + (1 - pi) C in points; bands: 2.5-97.5% of a joint question bootstrap (conflict and clean questions resampled within each pool, one draw shared by every setting); break-even CI over replicates with helps-at-every-share = 0 and helps-at-none = 1
